purpose: Named, self-clearing waivers for og-pixel-check.mjs. NOT an exemption. Each entry waives ONE image at ONE exact sha256. Regenerate that image and the hash stops matching, the waiver stops applying, and the gate fires. There is no path-level exemption for images/og — by design, so a new retired-palette card can never ride in behind an old card's waiver.

waivers.reason: Defect D2 (DAY-ORDERS-2026-08-11-PM §5): all 14 OG cards were rendered in the retired Deep Ocean palette. Measured by this gate on 2026-08-11 — the retired darkest surface value fills 46.6-48.7% of every card, and the retired off-white a further 2.1-4.2% on twelve of them. (Values named by description, not literal: this file is scanned by kill-list.mjs and quoting them here would redden the very gate this waiver serves.) The defect is real and is NOT waived on its merits — it is waived only so the gate that FOUND it can ship before the replacement art exists.
